{{Quote|Ayesho and Nil, two renowned Jedi with years of combat experience. Lord Kavos cut them down without suffering a single injury.|M1-4X|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Nil''' was an experienced [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who was present at a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Brentaal IV outpost|outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] when it was attacked by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kavos]]. Kavos single-handedly massacred the entire outpost, and defeated both Nil and another [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight, [[Ayesho]], together in combat.
